content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Sports team and ballpark with media rights and real estate leasing; no gym memberships or franchising."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Branded protein products sold through retailers; no membership or club operations."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Golf courses and entertainment venues sell play time; not membership-based gyms."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Digital publishing and advertising business; no physical fitness clubs or franchising."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Bowling entertainment centers selling lane time; different leisure business, not fitness."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Live entertainment venues and ticketing; no membership fitness or franchise model."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Vacation ownership sales and resort management; a timeshare business, not gyms."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Branded hot dog licensing and restaurant franchising; food business rather than fitness."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Sells connected home exercise equipment and streaming classes; no physical gym clubs or franchise system."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Guided tours, lodging and attractions at destinations; a travel business, not fitness."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Sports and lifestyle publishing monetized through advertising and affiliate commerce."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Movie theatres and hotels serving leisure guests; entertainment and hospitality, not gyms."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Upscale and Japanese restaurants with brand licensing; dining business, not fitness."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Quick-service hamburger restaurant franchisor; shares franchise royalties but sells food, not fitness."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Home furnishings retailer with private-label goods; retail business, not membership or fitness."}]}
